purpose: Higher-pixel native generation test using official-reference IPAdapter
workflow_profile: 32 steps, CFG 5.5, Euler ancestral, fp32 tiled VAE, batch 1, normal PyTorch CUDA execution

visual_verdict.1024x1536: Acceptable high-resolution output; clear linework and stable Emilia identity, but more spare composition in this seed.
visual_verdict.1152x1728: Preferred high-resolution output; visibly more detailed scene and coat linework with no observed OOM or obvious upscale artifact.
visual_verdict.selected: 1152x1728 native; use its 2304x3456 2x product when maximum pixel output is desired.
visual_verdict.caution: The 1152 image still has stylized linework and small hand/foot anatomy risks; high resolution does not guarantee semantic or anatomical perfection.

decision: Keep 1152x1728 as the high-pixel optional profile. Do not force 1280x1920 on this 8 GiB GPU without a tiled/latent-tiled strategy; current native 1152x1728 already uses the available memory safely and provides a meaningful clarity gain.
